q: How do I know which frame size to choose?
a: Each bike's page shows the rider height for every size. Between two sizes, send us your height and inside-leg and we will tell you which, or book a test ride.

q: Which bike for my first trails?
a: A hardtail with a 100 mm fork and hydraulic brakes — the Talon 2 or Talon 29 3. Move to full suspension when the trails you ride get rough.

q: Can I try a bike before I buy it?
a: Yes. Message us the bike and your size and we will have it ready on our test loop.

q: Do you deliver, and does it arrive built?
a: In town we deliver free, fully built and set up. Elsewhere in Vietnam it travels by courier in a box, 90% built, with a video call to finish it.
Bank transfer (we send a VietQR code when we confirm), cash on delivery in town, or card and cash at the shop.
We call within two hours of opening time to confirm size, stock and delivery. Nothing is charged before that call.

q: What warranty do the bikes have?
a: Two years on the frame from the shop, on top of the maker's own warranty, and parts for one year.
Yes — within three months of buying, cables stretch and bolts settle, so bring the bike back and we adjust it free.
